next.reason: 1985: "Cd-name-1 must reference an input CD or input-output CD."; 2023: "No CDs exist; SR-14.9.31.3-1 says instead: Data-name-1 shall be the name of a message-tag data item.". 2023 drops the communication module and CDs. Its RECEIVE takes a message-tag data item, so no rule requires an input or input-output CD.
